subject: Geography
description: Major Indian waterfalls — Jog, Kunchikal, Dudhsagar, Athirappilly, Bhagsu, Hogenakkal, Bhagsunath; states, rivers, height ranking.

questions.stem: Which is the TALLEST single-drop waterfall in INDIA?
questions.explanation: KUNCHIKAL FALLS — INDIA's TALLEST WATERFALL with cumulative drop of ~455 m (1,493 ft). Located in SHIMOGA district, KARNATAKA, on the VARAHI river (a Karnataka river). It's a 'TIERED' waterfall (drops in stages, not single-leap). RANKING — TALLEST WATERFALLS in INDIA (heights approximate, tiered drops): (1) KUNCHIKAL — 455 m (Karnataka, Varahi river). (2) BARKANA FALLS — 259 m (Karnataka, on Seeta river). (3) NOHKALIKAI FALLS — 340 m single drop (Meghalaya, Cherrapunji area) — many sources call this India's TALLEST PLUNGE WATERFALL. (4) NOHSNGITHIANG (Seven Sisters Falls) — 315 m (Meghalaya). (5) DUDHSAGAR — 310 m (Goa-Karnataka, Mandovi river). (6) JOG FALLS — 253 m (Karnataka, Sharavathi river — most FAMOUS). (7) ATHIRAPPILLY — 25 m (Kerala, Chalakudy — 'Niagara of India'). NOTE: 'tallest' depends on whether you count single drop or total tiered drop. NOHKALIKAI is sometimes claimed as tallest single-plunge (340m). Question/answer convention varies by source. JOG FALLS — 4 segments: RAJA, RANI, ROCKET, ROARER — most popular tourist waterfall. PYQ FREQUENCY: tallest waterfall is a top SSC GA, UPSC, NDA fact — 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: JOG FALLS, the famous waterfall in Karnataka, is on which river?
questions.explanation: JOG FALLS — on the SHARAVATHI RIVER, in the WESTERN GHATS, SHIMOGA district, Karnataka. River SHARAVATHI is a WEST-FLOWING river (drains into Arabian Sea at Honnavar). HEIGHT: ~253 m (829 ft). FOUR SEGMENTS (named with personalities): (1) RAJA (the 'King') — flows uninterrupted. (2) RANI (the 'Queen') — meanders gently. (3) ROARER — flows turbulently into deep gorge. (4) ROCKET — bursts out at high velocity. MONSOON SEASON (Jun-Sep) — most spectacular; in summer the volume is reduced due to upstream LINGANAMAKKI dam (built 1964 for Mahatma Gandhi Hydroelectric Project). KEY HYDRO PROJECT: Sharavathi Hydro Project — 1,469 MW capacity, one of India's earliest large hydropower stations. ALTERNATE NAMES: Jog is also known as GERSOPPA FALLS (after old downstream village) or JOGADA GUNDI. KEY GEOGRAPHIC INSIGHT — WEST-FLOWING vs EAST-FLOWING rivers in peninsula: West-flowing (Narmada, Tapi, Sharavathi, Periyar, Mandovi) drain to ARABIAN SEA; have STEEP gradient → many WATERFALLS. East-flowing (Krishna, Godavari, Kaveri, Mahanadi) drain to BAY OF BENGAL; flatter → DELTAS (e.g., Krishna-Godavari delta in AP). PYQ FREQUENCY: Jog-Sharavathi link is a top SSC, UPSC, KAS fact — 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: DUDHSAGAR FALLS, often featured in Bollywood films like 'Chennai Express', is located on the border of:
questions.explanation: DUDHSAGAR FALLS — on the MANDOVI RIVER, on the GOA-KARNATAKA border. Total drop ~310 m, in 4 tiers; INDIA's 4th-5th tallest waterfall depending on ranking method. NAME: 'Dudhsagar' = 'sea of milk' in Marathi/Konkani — the milky-white cascade resembles flowing milk. Located in BHAGWAN MAHAVEER WILDLIFE SANCTUARY + MOLLEM NATIONAL PARK. ACCESSIBLE BY: (1) Train (Konkan Railway passes near; the falls are visible from the train — iconic shot from 'Chennai Express' 2013, where Shahrukh Khan + Deepika Padukone climbed onto the train near the falls — NOT recommended IRL!). (2) Trek from Castle Rock (~12 km). (3) Jeep + boat from Goa side. (4) Train stop briefly at Dudhsagar station (Indian Railways stopped this in 2014 for safety after several deaths). MANDOVI RIVER — Goa's main river; flows through Goa's capital PANAJI (= Panjim), into Arabian Sea. SHARES TYPE: like Jog, Dudhsagar is a WESTERN GHATS waterfall on a WEST-FLOWING river. KONKAN RAILWAY — engineering marvel — runs along the western coast, opened 1998; spans 760 km from Roha (Maharashtra) to Mangaluru (Karnataka). PYQ FREQUENCY: Dudhsagar in Geography MCQs of SSC, IBPS GA — 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: ATHIRAPPILLY FALLS, called 'Niagara of India', is in which state?
questions.explanation: ATHIRAPPILLY FALLS — KERALA's largest waterfall, on the CHALAKUDY RIVER, in THRISSUR district. HEIGHT: ~25 m, but its WIDTH (330 m at full flow during monsoon) gives it 'Niagara of India' moniker. LOCATION: Western Ghats foothills, ~70 km from Kochi. ECOSYSTEM: VAZHACHAL Forest Division — biodiverse rainforest; home to several ENDEMIC HORNBILLS (Great Hornbill, Malabar Pied Hornbill, Indian Grey Hornbill, Malabar Grey Hornbill). FILMS: Bahubali (Telugu, 2015) shot the iconic waterfall scenes here; Dil Se (Hindi, 1998), Vinodayathra (Malayalam), Punarvasu (Tamil) — many films showcased Athirappilly. CONTROVERSY: a proposed ATHIRAPPILLY HYDROELECTRIC PROJECT (163 MW) has been DEBATED since 1990s. Environmentalists oppose due to wildlife damage; State govt has stalled it; latest reports (2024) suggest plans dropped. CHALAKUDY RIVER — flows from Anamalai Hills (Western Ghats) into ARABIAN SEA; total length ~145 km. NEAR ATTRACTIONS: VAZHACHAL Falls (downstream from Athirappilly), CHARPA Falls. KERALA TOURISM markets these as 'God's Own Country' essential visits. PYQ FREQUENCY: 'Niagara of India' tag in SSC GA, UPSC, KAS — 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: HOGENAKKAL FALLS, called 'Niagara of South India', is on which river?
questions.explanation: HOGENAKKAL FALLS — on the KAVERI RIVER, on the TAMIL NADU-KARNATAKA BORDER (Dharmapuri district, TN). Multi-channel cataract — water cascades through hundreds of small streams over rocks. NAME: 'Hogenakkal' in Kannada = 'smoking rocks' (mist creates smoke-like illusion). HEIGHT: ~20 m, but WIDTH and VOLUME are impressive. ATTRACTIONS: (1) CORACLE BOAT RIDES (round wicker-and-leather boats) for tourists — distinctive. (2) Therapeutic FISH SPA (small fish nibble dead skin — natural pedicure). (3) FRESH RIVER FISH cooked in coconut-based curries — specialty. KAVERI RIVER (also Cauvery): rises in TALAKAVERI (Brahmagiri Hills, KARNATAKA); flows through Karnataka, Tamil Nadu (~800 km); empties at POOMPUHAR delta into BAY OF BENGAL. KAVERI WATER DISPUTE: long-running between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu — Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal (1990); SC verdict 2018 finalized water-sharing. KEY KAVERI BASIN: Mekedatu reservoir proposal (Karnataka) is contested by Tamil Nadu. RELATED FALLS on KAVERI: Shivanasamudra Falls (Karnataka, ~98 m, twin falls — Bharachukki and Gaganachukki), generates 4,800 MW hydroelectricity. PYQ FREQUENCY: Hogenakkal-Kaveri link in SSC GA, UPSC 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: NOHKALIKAI FALLS, often cited as India's tallest plunge waterfall, is located in:
questions.explanation: NOHKALIKAI FALLS — INDIA's TALLEST PLUNGE (single-drop) WATERFALL at ~340 m (1,115 ft). Located in MEGHALAYA, near CHERRAPUNJI (Sohra), East Khasi Hills district. Cherrapunji is famous for being one of the WETTEST PLACES on EARTH (~11,777 mm annual rainfall). LEGEND: 'Nohkalikai' = 'jump of Likai' in Khasi — local legend tells of a woman 'Likai' who, after horror of finding out her infant was unintentionally killed, leaped from the cliff. SOURCE: small mountain stream; almost dries in winter (December-March), but FULL during monsoon (June-September). NEARBY: (1) MAWSMAI CAVES — limestone caves. (2) DAINTHLEN FALLS — another fall in the area. (3) NOHSNGITHIANG (Seven Sisters Falls) — 315 m, also in same area. (4) MAWSYNRAM (16 km from Cherrapunji) — wettest place in India by some measures (11,873 mm/yr, beating Cherrapunji's 11,777). MEGHALAYA = 'abode of clouds' in Sanskrit. STATE TRIVIA: capital SHILLONG ('Scotland of the East'). UMIAM LAKE near Shillong. LIVING ROOTS BRIDGES of Cherrapunji — UNESCO heritage natural engineering marvels. PYQ FREQUENCY: Meghalaya-rainfall-waterfall MCQs in SSC, UPSC.

questions.stem: Which state hosts the SHIVANASAMUDRA Falls, used for India's earliest hydropower project?

options.option_text: Tamil Nadu also on Kaveri now

questions.explanation: SHIVANASAMUDRA FALLS — on the KAVERI RIVER in MANDYA district, KARNATAKA. SEGMENTED INTO TWO: (1) GAGANACHUKKI (left/west) and (2) BHARACHUKKI (right/east) — Kaveri SPLITS around Shivanasamudra ISLAND, then both branches re-merge downstream. HEIGHT: ~98 m. HYDROPOWER HISTORY: HOUSE OF MYSORE (Wodeyars) commissioned the SHIVANASAMUDRA HYDROELECTRIC PROJECT in 1902 — INDIA's FIRST major hydroelectric power plant; transmitted power to KOLAR GOLD FIELDS (147 km away) — at the time, the LONGEST high-voltage transmission in the world. POWER OUTPUT today: ~42 MW. ENGINEER: Sir M. VISVESVARAYA (1860-1962) — the legendary Indian engineer; later DIWAN of MYSORE. He's the namesake of ENGINEER'S DAY (15 September, his birthday). KAVERI WATERFALLS RANKING: (1) Shivanasamudra ~98 m (Karnataka). (2) Hogenakkal ~20 m (KA-TN border). (3) various rapids upstream. KOLAR GOLD FIELDS: closed permanently in 2001 after deep mining became unprofitable. SHIVANASAMUDRA TODAY: ~3-hour drive from Bengaluru; popular weekend destination + photographer's haven. PYQ ANGLE: Shivanasamudra-first-hydropower link in UPSC, KAS, SSC — 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: Chitrakoot Falls, regarded as the widest waterfall in India, is formed by which river?
questions.explanation: Chitrakoot Falls on the Indravati river in Bastar district, Chhattisgarh, stretches nearly 90 m in width during monsoon, earning its 'Indian Niagara' label for breadth rather than height. Mahanadi is tempting because it also originates in Chhattisgarh, but it does not form Chitrakoot; that honour belongs to the Indravati.

questions.stem: Dhuandhar Falls, whose name translates to 'smoke cascade', is created by which river flowing over marble rocks near Jabalpur?

options.option_text: Tapti river near Betul in Madhya Pradesh
Narmada river near Jabalpur in Madhya Pradesh
Betwa river near Orchha in Madhya Pradesh

questions.explanation: Dhuandhar ('धुआंधार') means misty or smoke-like torrent; it forms where the Narmada crashes through the marble gorge at Bhedaghat, Jabalpur. The Chambal is a frequently guessed distractor because it is Madhya Pradesh's other famous river, but it does not produce Dhuandhar Falls.

questions.stem: Kunchikal Falls, often cited as the tallest waterfall in India at roughly 455 m, is formed by which river in Karnataka?

options.option_text: Sharavathi river in Uttara Kannada district
Kali river flowing through Dandeli district
Netravathi river in Dakshina Kannada district

questions.explanation: Kunchikal Falls on the Varahi river in Shivamogga district is India's tallest waterfall by total vertical drop (~455 m). Sharavathi is the most common wrong answer because the more famous Jog Falls is on the Sharavathi — but Jog is only ~253 m, far shorter than Kunchikal.

questions.stem: Nohsngithiang Falls, popularly called 'Seven Sisters Falls' because it splits into seven parallel streams, is located near Sohra (Cherrapunji) in which district of Meghalaya?

options.option_text: East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya
West Jaintia Hills district of Meghalaya
South Garo Hills district of Meghalaya
East Garo Hills district of Meghalaya

questions.explanation: Nohsngithiang (Seven Sisters Falls) lies near Mawsmai village, Sohra (Cherrapunji), which falls in East Khasi Hills district. It is seasonal, flowing mainly during monsoon. West Jaintia Hills is a likely distractor because Meghalaya's Nohkalikai is often confused with other district-level placements.

questions.stem: Meenmutty Falls, a three-tiered cascade dropping about 300 m in Kerala, is situated inside which protected area?

options.option_text: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary in Wayanad district
Periyar Tiger Reserve in Idukki district
Parambikulam Tiger Reserve in Palakkad district
Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary in Idukki district

questions.explanation: Meenmutty Falls (distinct from a smaller namesake near Thiruvananthapuram) lies within the Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, accessible via a trek from Kalpetta. Periyar is the most tempting distractor as it is Kerala's best-known wildlife reserve, but the falls are geographically in Wayanad, not Idukki.

questions.stem: Thalaiyar Falls (Rat Tail Falls), one of the tallest waterfalls in peninsular India at ~297 m, is a cascade on the Manjalar river. The Manjalar is a tributary of which river?

options.option_text: Cauvery river, draining through the Cauvery delta
Tamirabarani river, draining into Gulf of Mannar
Palar river, draining into the Bay of Bengal
Vaigai river, draining near Ramanathapuram coast

questions.explanation: The Manjalar river in Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu, joins the Vaigai river; Thalaiyar Falls cascades off the Palani Hills into this system. Cauvery is the dominant river of Tamil Nadu and is therefore the most attractive wrong answer, but the falls lie in the Vaigai catchment, not the Cauvery basin.

questions.stem: Duduma Falls on the Machkund river is a significant waterfall and the site of a major hydroelectric project. It lies on the inter-state border between which two states?

options.option_text: Chhattisgarh and Telangana at the Godavari basin
Andhra Pradesh and Telangana along Eastern Ghats
Odisha and Chhattisgarh in the Mahanadi watershed
Odisha and Andhra Pradesh along the Eastern Ghats

questions.explanation: Duduma Falls is on the Machkund river where it forms the natural boundary between Koraput district (Odisha) and Vizianagaram/Srikakulam (Andhra Pradesh); the Machkund Hydroelectric Project harnesses it jointly. Odisha–Chhattisgarh is a common wrong pick because Chhattisgarh borders Odisha and also has major waterfall sites.
